findings.evidence: `rg` finds `@[expose] def` at `Scheme/Basic.lean:57`, `Scheme/AffineDedekind.lean:55,96,140,199`, and `FractionalIdealDivisor/Effectivity.lean:99`; the restricted equivalences only have forward coercion lemmas at Effectivity.lean:124 and AffineDedekind.lean:223.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]`; add coercion/application lemmas for the two restricted equivalences’ inverse maps (and any other genuinely needed observations) so consumers never unfold them.
findings.issue: The bodies of `codimensionOnePointEquivOfIso`, `heightOneSpectrumEquivCodimensionOnePoint`, `affineDedekindPointEquiv`, `integralFractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv`, `affineDedekindWeilCartierAddEquiv`, and `affineDedekindEffectiveWeilCartierAddEquiv` are public via `@[expose]`, making downstream code depend on implementation details.

summary: The characteristic forward APIs are now present, but six equivalence implementations remain unnecessarily exposed, including restricted equivalences with no inverse characterization lemma.
